## Problem

What is wrong or missing, and who it affects.

## Change

What this pull request does, in a few sentences.

## Proof

Tests added or changed, and screenshots from the verification skill driving the real app.
For physics changes: the validation level reached (model vs analysis, vs references, scripted students).

## Risk

What could break, and how we would notice and roll back.

- [ ] Keyboard and screen-reader checked
